project.name: Pontesbury Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 4 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 15 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Pontesbury qualifies as a local detour through Ringwork and tower keep castle 170m south east of St George's Church and Church of St George. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Pontesbury: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Pontesbury offers Ringwork and tower keep castle 170m south east of St George's Church, Church of St George within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
